label: Notch 68° (Curved Gorge)
description: The curved gorge notch at 68 degrees is a distinctly Italian refinement in which the gorge seam follows a gentle curve rather than a straight line, softening what would otherwise be a sharp mechanical angle into something more sculptural and alive. Associated with Florentine and Milanese ateliers, this lapel style communicates craftsmanship and intentionality — the curve is invisible to a casual observer but signals to the trained eye that the jacket was made with unusual care. The overall effect is a notch lapel that appears to melt naturally into the collar rather than simply joining it.
